title: Microsoft CEO Nadella Sells $43 Million of Stock
summary: Microsoft  CEO Satya Nadella sold over $43 million worth of company stock under a pre-arranged trading plan, marking his first sale of the year.  A Form 4 filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission shows Nadella unloaded 86,525 shares across eight separate transactions on Sept. 1 at prices ranging from $497.69 to $505.76 each.  The transactions were conducted under a 105b-1 trading plan, which is triggered when pre-determined conditions such as stock price or date are met.
